newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Oct 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Oct 4.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
Official commentary says it is wrong to sacrifice cultural and ideological progress to economic construction.
Official commentary accuses Taiwanese officials of going back on their word and worsening the economic situation on the island.

Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesman Shen Guofang expresses indignation over report that Japan's Liberal Democratic Party had included controversial issues concerning World War Two and a group of disputed islands in the East China Sea in its election platform.
A commentary urges merger of small and medium-sized state enterprises.
The Agricultural Bank of China gives loans of $7.9 billion to carry out state purchases of farm products by the end of August.
The Shenzhen stock exchange is upgrading its satellite telecommunication links for share quotations and transactions.
China sees a booming chemical fibre market amid rising loans to the textile sector and a slumping cotton market.
A central bank survey finds urban residents are spending more and investing more in stocks following recent interest rate cuts.
